pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients and low edge angularity. Patch scale is significantly larger on the left (anterior) portion of the neck and decreases in area towards the right.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with distinct 3-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, though edges are blurred due to image resolution.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour with a soft pixel boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear ridge or structural boundary is visible on the central-left lateral neck surface, where there is a distinct discontinuity in patch scale and orientation.
